name: Brooklyn Aquarium Society (BASNY)
neighborhoods: Brooklyn / NYC; meets at New York Aquarium Education Hall, Coney Island
region_note: FISH & AQUATIC (aquarium fish, goldfish, bettas; aquatic turtles are under reptiles)
notes: Non-profit aquarium society founded 1911; monthly meetings (2nd Friday, except summer) with a live auction of donated fish, plants and corals - the practical way NYC aquarists rehome fish and get set-up advice. Not a formal rescue, but a real, active NYC venue for placing aquatic livestock responsibly. NEVER release aquarium fish/plants into local waters (invasive + illegal). Phone: (via basny.org contacts) Email: (via basny.org about-contacts) Intake: Rehome fish/plants/corals by donating to the monthly live auction (2nd Friday, New York Aquarium Education Hall, 610 Surf Ave, Brooklyn) Intake: members get a 50/50 split on livestock.
